title: Dev Spark catchup crib — Morgan Ellis
content:
Goal: 25–30 min prep + 30 min meeting. Focus: unblock current sprint work, calibrate growth signals for IC3→IC4 promotion roadmap, and sync on mentorship time.

Quick context (one-liners):
- Project: "Spark" - latency optimization for small-batch async routing. Morgan is owning the batching adapter and A/B eval harness.
- Sprint health: on track but batch adapter flaky under tail latency tests (seen on staging runs 2028-02-09).
- Career signal: Morgan shipped cross-team async batching PoC; needs visible leadership examples and more docs.

Agenda (timeboxed):
1) 5m - Warm check-in: energy, capacity, any immediate blockers I should know about.
2) 10m - Sprint focused: reproduce tail-latency failure, walk through logs/PR snapshot, next short experiment.
3) 8m - Career & growth: IC4 readiness rubric alignment, concrete examples to collect for promotion packet.
4) 5m - Mentorship & priorities: which mentees need attention, meeting cadence adjustment.
5) 2m - Close: assign action items + confirm next touchpoint.

Prep notes for me (manager):
- Bring up the stage-gate for the batching adapter: if we can hit 95% CI on tail latency in two tries, greenlight wider canary.
- Probe ownership: ask Morgan to explain the tradeoffs between KV cache priming vs aggressive batching (I want to hear their decision process).
- Offer help on visibility: propose running short demo at eng sync and draft slide text with Morgan.
- Reminder: reference IC4 rubric section "cross-team influence" — we need 2+ cross-team wins or clear leadership artifacts.

Blocker details (to discuss):
- Staging flake: p99 spikes when queue depth > 12. Hypothesis: garbage collection behavior in runtime v0.9.2 combined with batching window.
- Test flakiness: some e2e runs fail nondeterministically; need a reproducible small test case. Consider adding deterministic seed and local harness.

Key questions to ask Morgan:
- What minimal change can we try in next 24–48h to reduce the p99 spike? (config or code?)
- Who on infra/devtools do we need to loop in if we suspect GC interaction? (name + ask me to make intro)
- Which two "cross-team" artifacts can you ship in 6 weeks that demonstrate influence? (assess feasibility)

Promotion evidence checklist (quick sketch to collect):
- Technical breadth: owned an end-to-end change touching runtime + routing (example: Spark PoC) — need PR/notes.
- Leadership: ran 2+ design reviews with other teams and led one mitigation postmortem — collect links.
- Mentorship: list mentees + outcomes (pairing sessions, career check-ins) — ask Morgan to send short bullet per mentee.
- Impact metrics: estimated cost improvement or latency percentiles improved (attach before/after numbers).

Possible small wins to suggest in meeting:
- Ship focused doc: "Spark batching adapter: 4 easy experiments" — I can co-author and give a deadline.
- Demo at next weekly eng sync (5–7min) — increases visibility for promotion packet.
- Pair with infra engineer (Devika) for one debugging session to narrow GC hypothesis.

Action items template (fill during meeting):
- Action: Reproduce p99 spike with deterministic seed. Owner: Morgan. Due: 2028-02-15.
- Action: Draft 1-page "Spark experiments" doc. Owner: Morgan + Aisha (review). Due: 2028-02-18.
- Action: Schedule 1-hour pairing session with Devika to reproduce/runtime trace. Owner: Morgan + Devika. Due: 2028-02-14.
- Action: Put together promotion evidence list (PR links, talks, mentee notes). Owner: Morgan. Due: 2028-02-25.
- Action: I will draft 2-slide demo outline for eng sync and share by EOD after meeting. Owner: Morgan Ellis (me: coach). Due: 2028-02-13.

Notes-to-self (manager meta):
- Be careful not to solve everything immediately — encourage Morgan to own experiments. Use Socratic prompts.
- If Morgan seems low bandwidth, deprioritize demo and focus on repro + one cross-team artifact.
- If they ask for promotion advice, be explicit on timeline and concrete deliverables (two cross-team deliverables + measurable impact).

Follow-up template to send after meeting (quick email/DM copy):
---
Thanks for the sync — notes:
- Repro p99 spike: owner Morgan, due 2/15
- Spark doc draft: owner Morgan, due 2/18 (Aisha review)
- Pairing session with Devika: scheduled target 2/14
- Promotion evidence list: owner Morgan, due 2/25
Next check: quick standup on repro status Tue 2/14, full 1:1 in two weeks.
---

Open curiosities / ideas to jog discussion
- Could we run a small synthetic workload that mirrors production tail patterns? (ask SRE)
- Is there a way to surface per-request KV cache hit rates in the trace? Useful signal.
- Low-cost experiment: reduce batching window by 10ms in canary to see p99 impact.

Meeting artifacts to bring: staging logs snapshot (2028-02-09), PR#891 diff, quick perf chart screenshot.
